title: Add public marketing landing page with blush theme, CTA, screenshot carousel, and footer investor-interest link

requirements.text: Create a new single-page public marketing landing page for GrowInLove that is shown to unauthenticated visitors instead of the current centered login-only welcome screen.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user is not authenticated, the app renders a full marketing landing page (not only a login card).
When the user is authenticated, the existing in-app tab UI (Top Bar + BottomNav + tabs) remains unchanged.
Landing page is mobile-first and has a sensible desktop layout variant (responsive).

requirements.text: Implement the landing page sections from the approved wireframe and project scope: header (logo + light/dark toggle), hero (tree-inspired branding), benefit trio, product screenshot carousel, founder story section (using the provided founder story content already in the project context), privacy reassurance section, optional feature deep-dives section, final CTA section, and footer. Do not include testimonials/social proof.

quotes: Remove testimonials/social proof section from landing page for now (no testimonials available)

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page contains: Hero, Benefit Trio (3 blocks), Product Screenshot Carousel, Founder Story, Privacy Reassurance, Optional Feature Deep-dives, Final CTA, Footer.
No testimonials/social proof section is present on the landing page.
Each section is reachable via scroll and has stable anchor IDs suitable for footer navigation (e.g., #about, #contact, etc.).

requirements.text: Add a primary landing-page CTA that links directly to the deployed app experience (the authenticated app shell), and provide a secondary CTA that brings users to sign in (Internet Identity) if they choose. Ensure the CTA behavior is clear and works without introducing a router.

quotes: Landing page primary CTA button links directly to the deployed app

acceptanceCriteria: The landing page includes a prominent primary CTA button.
Clicking the primary CTA navigates into the app experience (same deployment) in a deterministic way (e.g., hash/query-based mode switch) without breaking the existing tab-based SPA.
A sign-in affordance exists on the landing page and successfully initiates Internet Identity login (reusing existing LoginButton behavior).

requirements.text: Apply a consistent blush/cream romantic aesthetic to the landing page and ensure it fully supports the existing light/dark theme system (including a visible theme toggle on the landing page).

quotes: Landing page theming: blush aesthetic with mandatory light/dark mode toggle

acceptanceCriteria: Landing page visually matches a blush/cream romantic design and remains readable and visually coherent in both light and dark modes.
Theme toggle is accessible from the landing page header and correctly switches themes using the existing ThemeProvider/ThemeToggle behavior.
No edits are made to immutable frontend paths; composition/wrapping is used where needed.

requirements.text: Implement the landing page footer with labeled links: About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, plus an investor-interest link labeled exactly “Interested in supporting our growth?”. Ensure each footer link has a clear text label (including the existing ones) and behaves consistently.

quotes:
Footer:
• About
• Contact
• Terms
• Privacy
• Investor‑Interest Link: “Interested in supporting our growth?”

acceptanceCriteria: Footer displays five text labels: About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, and “Interested in supporting our growth?”.
Clicking About/Contact/Terms/Privacy navigates to a corresponding landing-page section or opens a simple on-page modal/sheet with placeholder content (no dead links).

Investor-interest link label text matches exactly: “Interested in supporting our growth?” and navigates to a corresponding landing-page section or modal with a clear next step (placeholder text is acceptable if no contact endpoint is provided).

requirements.text: Add a product screenshot carousel to the landing page using static images bundled with the frontend (no backend calls). Include basic controls (swipe on mobile and clickable next/prev on desktop) and ensure images are responsive and performant.

quotes: Landing page sections: hero, benefit trio, product screenshot carousel...

acceptanceCriteria: Carousel renders at least 3 screenshots from frontend static assets and works in both light and dark modes.
On mobile, carousel supports swipe/drag; on desktop, carousel supports next/prev controls.
Images are loaded from the frontend public assets (not fetched from backend).

requirements.text: Use the user-uploaded tree-and-hearts image as branding inspiration by generating new logo/wordmark and a hero illustration variant as static assets, and update the landing page header/hero to use them. Keep existing in-app logo usage unchanged unless explicitly replaced on the landing page only.

quotes: Use uploaded tree-and-hearts image as logo inspiration for landing page branding

acceptanceCriteria: New generated branding assets exist in frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by the landing page.
Landing page header shows the new wordmark/logo assets and the hero section uses the new illustration.
The authenticated in-app shell continues to work and is not visually broken by landing-page asset changes.

constraints: Backend remains single-actor Motoko architecture; no new backend canisters/services.

Do not edit any frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*).
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is permitted.
Do not add a testimonials/social proof section to the landing page.
nonGoals: Implementing real Terms/Privacy legal copy (placeholders are acceptable unless provided elsewhere).
Adding a full routing solution (e.g., React Router) or moving away from the existing tab-based SPA design.
Changing backend data models or adding backend endpoints for the landing page.
